1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Harta Pusaka Kecil (Pembahagian) (Pindaan) 2024.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 15 Julai 2024.

Pindaan am

2. Peraturan-Peraturan Harta Pusaka Kecil (Pembahagian) 1955 [L.N. 495/1955],

yang disebut "Peraturan-Peraturan ibu" dalam Peraturan-Peraturan ini, dipinda dengan

menggantikan perkataan "Land Administrator" di mana-mana jua terdapat dengan

perkataan "Estate Distribution Officer".

Pindaan peraturan 1A

3. Peraturan 1A Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan memasukkan sebelum takrif

"Principal Registry" takrif yang berikut:

‘ "person" includes an individual, a creditor, a purchaser, the Corporation,

the Majlis, a guardian or next friend;'.

Penggantian peraturan 2

4. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan peraturan 2

dengan peraturan yang berikut:

"Forms. 2. (1) All forms required to be lodged or filed with

the Estate Distribution Officer under these Regulations shall be

lodged or filed at the Estate Distribution Office unless

the Estate Distribution Officer determines otherwise.

 (2) The forms to be used for the purposes of these Regulations

shall be as specified in the First Schedule.".

Penggantian peraturan 3

5. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan peraturan 3

dengan peraturan yang berikut:

"Petition and

search by

Principal

Registry.

3. (1) A petition for distribution of small estate shall be lodged

by a petitioner in Form A to the Estate Distribution Officer.

 (2) Upon receipt of the petition under subregulation (1),

the Estate Distribution Officer shall complete Part I of Form B

and notify the Principal Registry in any manner required

by the Principal Registry.

 (3) Upon receipt of the notification under subregulation (2),

the Registrar shall cause search to be made for any previous

application in respect of the estate of the deceased person

referred to in the petition.

(4) The Registrar shall certify within a period of one month

the finding of the search in Form C to the Estate Distribution Officer,

in default of which the Estate Distribution Officer may proceed

with the issuance of a notice of hearing in Form D or

a notice of inquiry in Form DDB, as the case may be.".

Peraturan baharu 3C

6. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan memasukkan selepas peraturan 3B

peraturan yang berikut:

"Inquiry. 3C. (1) Upon receipt of a petition under regulation 3,

an application under regulation 3A or a subsequent application

under regulation 12, the Estate Distribution Officer may conduct

an inquiry to verify any information or document relating to

such petition, application or subsequent application.

(2) For the purposes of subregulation (1),

the Estate Distribution Officer shall issue a notice of inquiry

in Form DDB to the petitioner, applicant or any other person

to attend the inquiry and shall cause such notice of inquiry

to be served.

(3) The issuance of the notice of inquiry by the

Estate Distribution Officer shall not be less than seven days from

the date of hearing.

(4) In the course of inquiry, the Estate Distribution Officer

may require the petitioner, applicant or any other person to furnish

any information or document as may be necessary.

(5) If the information or document required under

subregulation (3) has not been furnished, the Estate Distribution

Officer may dismiss the petition or application referred to

in subregulation (1).".

Penggantian peraturan 4

7. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan peraturan 4

dengan peraturan yang berikut:

"Notice of

 hearing for

 petition.

4. (1) Pursuant to the search by the Registrar under

subregulation 3(4)—

(a) where there is a previous application

in respect of the estate of the deceased,

the Estate Distribution Officer shall strike out

the petition and inform the petitioner; or

(b) where there is no previous application

in respect of the estate of the deceased,

the Estate Distribution Officer shall issue

to the petitioner a notice of hearing for petition

in Form D.

(2) The issuance of the notice of hearing for petition

by the Estate Distribution Officer shall not be less than seven days

from the date of hearing.

 (3) Upon receipt of the notice of hearing for petition

under paragraph (1)(b), the petitioner shall serve a copy of such

notice of hearing for petition on all persons who are named

and addressed in the petition as required under section 9 of the Act

by hand, post or by electronic communications.

 (4) The Estate Distribution Officer may require any person

to appear before him to give evidence or to produce any document

in his possession in relation to the petition.

(5) Any person who does not comply with the requirement

under subregulation (3), the Estate Distribution Officer may issue

a notice of directions in Form DD.".

Penggantian peraturan 5

8. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan peraturan 5

dengan peraturan yang berikut:

"Transfer to

High Court or

another

Estate

Distribution

Officer.

5. (1) If the estate of the deceased is a not a small estate,

the Estate Distribution Officer shall transfer to the Registrar

of the appropriate High Court the petition referred to

in subregulation 3(1) in Form I.

 (2) If the estate is a small estate and it would be

more expedient for the petition to be heard by

the Estate Distribution Officer of any other State pursuant to

subsection 4(2) of the Act, the Estate Distribution Officer

shall submit to the President of Estate Distribution an application

for transfer of the petition in Form Q.

(3) Upon receipt of application for transfer,

the President of Estate Distribution shall make an order of transfer

in Form R and the Estate Distribution Officer of any other State

shall deal with the petition.".

Penggantian peraturan 6

9. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan peraturan 6

dengan peraturan yang berikut:

Peraturan baharu 6A, 6B dan 6C

10. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan memasukkan selepas peraturan 6

peraturan yang berikut:

"Service of

notice.

6. Any notice issued under these Regulations to be served

on the petitioner, applicant or any person relating to

the estate of the deceased may be effected by hand, post or

by electronic communications.".

"Hearing. 6A. (1) The petitioner or any person who is required to

attend the hearing under subregulation 4(1) shall attend

the hearing on the date and time and at the place specified

in the notice of hearing.

 (2) Where the petitioner or such person does not attend

the hearing without any reasonable cause, the Estate Distribution

Officer may dismiss the petition if the Estate Distribution Officer

is satisfied that the notice of hearing for petition has been served

on the petitioner or such person.

 Summary

distribution.

6B. (1) The petitioner or applicant referred to in section 8B

of the Act may apply for a summary distribution order

to the Estate Distribution Officer in Form DDC.

 (2) Upon receipt of the application under

subregulation (1), the Estate Distribution Officer may require

the petitioner or applicant to furnish additional documents within

a period as he thinks fit from the date the application is received.

 (3) The Estate Distribution Officer shall, after considering

the application and the additional documents—

(a) issue to the petitioner or applicant

a distribution order in Form E;

(b) grant to the petitioner or applicant

a letter of administration in Form F; or

(c) issue to the applicant a subsequent application

order in Form T.

(4) Where the petitioner or applicant who does not

comply with the requirement under subregulation (2),

the Estate Distribution Officer may dismiss the application

for a summary distribution and may proceed with

the issuance of a notice of hearing for petition in Form D,

or in the case of subsequent application, with the issuance

of a notice of hearing in Form S.

Letters of

administration

pendente lite.

6C. (1) A petitioner or any beneficiary of the estate

of the deceased may, at any time pending the issuance

of any distribution order, apply in writing or in any manner

as determined by the Estate Distribution Officer for

a letter of administration pendente lite for the purpose of obtaining

information from any party in respect of the estate of the deceased.

(2) Upon receipt of the application under

subregulation (1), the Estate Distribution Officer shall,

if he thinks fit, grant a letter of administration pendente lite

in Form FA.

(3) The letter of administration pendente lite

granted under subregulation (2) shall be valid for the period

of three months from the date the letter of administration

pendente lite is granted.".

Pindaan peraturan 7

11. Peraturan 7 Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda—

(a) dengan menggantikan subperaturan (1) dengan subperaturan yang

berikut:

"(1) At the conclusion of the summary distribution or hearing,

the Estate Distribution Officer may perform all or any of the following:

(a) make a distribution order in Form E;

(b) grant a letter of administration in Form F."; dan

(b) dengan memotong subperaturan (2).

friend and

8. (1) For the purposes of section 10 of the Act,

a minor or a person of unsound mind, or a next friend for

 (2) For the purposes of paragraph 13(2)(b) of the Act,

an order for the entry of a caveat to protect the interest of

the beneficiary who is a minor or a person of unsound mind shall be

in Form HH.".

(b) dengan menggantikan subperaturan (7) dengan subperaturan yang

"(7) Upon the determination of the collateral dispute pursuant to

Penggantian peraturan 12

15. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan peraturan 12

"Subsequent

application.

12. (1) An application made in accordance with section 17

of the Act subsequent to the determination of the suit shall be

in Form P and upon receipt of such application,

the Estate Distribution Officer shall issue a notice of hearing

for subsequent application in Form S.

(2) The issuance of the notice of hearing for

subsequent application by the Estate Distribution Officer

shall not be less than seven days from the date of hearing.

(3) Where the applicant does not attend the hearing

without any reasonable cause, the Estate Distribution Officer

may dismiss the application if the Estate Distribution Officer

is satisfied that the notice of hearing for an application

has been served on the applicant.

(4) At the conclusion of the summary distribution or hearing

under this regulation, the Estate Distribution Officer may—

Penggantian peraturan 12A

16. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan peraturan 12A

dengan peraturan yang berikut:

"Amendment

of order.

12A. Where an order issued under these Regulations is unable

to be registered or enforced, the Estate Distribution Officer may,

with prior approval of the President of Estate Distribution,

amend the order.".

Pemotongan peraturan 13, 14 dan 16

17. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan memotong peraturan 13, 14 dan 16.

Penggantian peraturan 16A

18. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan peraturan 16A

dengan peraturan yang berikut:

"Sale of

property.

16A. (1) Upon receipt of subsequent application by

an administrator under regulation 12, the Estate Distribution Officer

may order for the sale of property as provided for in the application.

(2) Prior to the issuance of the order under

subregulation (1), the Estate Distribution Officer shall take

into consideration that —

(a) any potential buyer to the property has been

ascertained; and

(a) make a subsequent application order in Form T; or

(b) grant a letter of administration in Form F.".

(b) the sale price of the property is equal

to the market value of the property or any value

as agreed by the beneficiary.".

Pemotongan peraturan 16AA

19. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan memotong peraturan 16AA.

Penggantian peraturan 16B

20. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan peraturan 16B

dengan peraturan yang berikut:

"Sale of

property by

tender

among the

beneficiaries.

16B. (1) In the exercise of his duties under paragraph 15(4)(d)

of the Act, the Estate Distribution Officer may order the land

or any part of it to be sold by tender among the beneficiaries.

 (2) Prior to the issuance of the order under subregulation (1),

the Estate Distribution Officer shall—

(a) specify the distributive proportions due to

the respective beneficiaries or the amount

due to the creditor, the payment of estate duty,

if any, out of the estate of the deceased,

and the payment in respect of funeral expenses

at the date on which the order is made; and

(b) fix a reserve price for the purposes of

the sale of property by tender, being a price

equal to the market value of the property or

undivided distributive shares in question

as estimated by the Estate Distribution Officer

at the date of the tender.

 (3) In specifying or fixing any amount for the purposes

of sale of property by tender among the beneficiaries,

the Estate Distribution Officer shall have regard to any other

liabilities which will have to be paid out of the proceeds

of sale of property by tender among the beneficiaries.".

Peraturan baharu 16BA

21. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan memasukkan selepas peraturan 16B

peraturan yang berikut:

"Sale of land

by majority

consent.

16BA. (1) Subject to subsection 15(4A) of the Act,

the Estate Distribution Officer shall offer the land or part of it

to be purchased by the beneficiary who does not consent

to the sale of the land or part of it.

(2) If the beneficiary referred to in subregulation (1)

refuse to purchase the land or part of it, the Estate Distribution Officer

may open to tender such land or part of it to other beneficiaries

or any other potential buyers.".

Pemotongan peraturan 16C

22. Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda dengan memotong peraturan 16C.

Pindaan peraturan 18

23. Peraturan 18 Peraturan-Peraturan ibu dipinda—

(a) dalam subperaturan (1)—

"(3) The fees specified in the Second Schedule shall apply

to any rehearing of petition or application before the Estate Distribution

Officer as ordered by the High Court.".

SMALL ESTATES (DISTRIBUTION) (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 30 of the Small Estates (Distribution)

Act 1955 [Act 98], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Small Estates (Distribution)

(Amendment) Regulations 2024.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 15 July 2024.

General amendment

2. The Small Estates (Distribution) Regulations 1955 [L.N. 495 of 1955],

which are referred to as the "principal Regulations" in these Regulations,

are amended by substituting for the words "Land Administrator" wherever appearing

the words "Estate Distribution Officer".

Amendment of regulation 1A

3. Regulation 1A of the principal Regulations is amended by inserting before

the definition of "Principal Registry" the following definition:

 ‘ "person" includes an individual, a creditor, a purchaser, the Corporation,

the Majlis, a guardian or next friend;'.

4. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for regulation 2

the following regulation:

"Forms. 2. (1) All forms required to be lodged or filed with

the Estate Distribution Officer under these Regulations shall be

lodged or filed at the Estate Distribution Office unless

the Estate Distribution Officer determines otherwise.

 (2) The forms to be used for the purposes of these Regulations

shall be as specified in the First Schedule.".

Substitution of regulation 3

5. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for regulation 3

the following regulation:

"Petition and

search by

Principal

Registry.

3. (1) A petition for distribution of small estate shall be lodged

by a petitioner in Form A to the Estate Distribution Officer.

 (2) Upon receipt of the petition under subregulation (1),

the Estate Distribution Officer shall complete Part I of Form B

and notify the Principal Registry in any manner required

by the Principal Registry.

 (3) Upon receipt of the notification under subregulation (2),

the Registrar shall cause search to be made for any previous

application in respect of the estate of the deceased person

referred to in the petition.

(4) The Registrar shall certify within a period of one month

the finding of the search in Form C to the Estate Distribution Officer,

in default of which the Estate Distribution Officer may proceed

with the issuance of a notice of hearing in Form D or

a notice of inquiry in Form DDB, as the case may be.".

New regulation 3C

6. The principal Regulations are amended by inserting after regulation 3B

the following regulation:

"Inquiry. 3C. (1) Upon receipt of a petition under regulation 3,

an application under regulation 3A or a subsequent application

under regulation 12, the Estate Distribution Officer may conduct

an inquiry to verify any information or document relating to

such petition, application or subsequent application.

(2) For the purposes of subregulation (1),

the Estate Distribution Officer shall issue a notice of inquiry

in Form DDB to the petitioner, applicant or any other person

to attend the inquiry and shall cause such notice of inquiry

to be served.

(3) The issuance of the notice of inquiry by the

Estate Distribution Officer shall not be less than seven days from

the date of hearing.

(4) In the course of inquiry, the Estate Distribution Officer

may require the petitioner, applicant or any other person to furnish

any information or document as may be necessary.

(5) If the information or document required under

subregulation (3) has not been furnished, the Estate Distribution

Officer may dismiss the petition or application referred to

in subregulation (1).".

the following regulation:

 hearing for

 petition.

another
